_comment: Global site facts per founder decisions 2026-07-19: brand 'RichenQuest' + descriptive tagline; canonical https://www.richenquest.com (apex 301s to www); official@ email; both India + Italy numbers displayed; WhatsApp = Italy number (as on legacy site).
_values_are_presentation_neutral: Store PLAIN values only — real '&', real spaces. These fields feed JSON-LD <script> blocks (head.html, contact.html) where entities are NOT decoded and a stray '&' or non-breaking space corrupts the structured data search engines read. Typography (non-breaking phone numbers, escaped ampersands) belongs in the templates and CSS, never here. See .htmlvalidate.json.
name: RichenQuest
_zoho_webform_return_url_note: Points at the CURRENT live origin. www.richenquest.com still serves the old Zoho Sites page, so returning there would land submitters on a 404 on the legacy site. Flip to https://www.richenquest.com/contact/thank-you/ at DNS cutover.
